title: allowed_institutions: effective-set relation grid (equal, strict subset, empty, non-subset) against the caller set
baseline_behaviour: allowed_institutions must be a frozenset of non-empty str (377-387); membership is exact (`in`). Equal set: identical verdicts to the caller policy. Strict subset: operations outside the subset denied with 'local institution restriction'. Empty frozenset: accepted by __post_init__ (no emptiness check) and denies every operation in that dimension. A set containing an element outside the caller set is not a Runtime concept: the evaluator would accept a wider set; refusing it is the adapter's non-widening gate.
candidate_comparison: Grid for allowed_institutions with the other four sets held equal to the caller: (1) equal: verdicts byte-identical to the unmodified caller policy over the oracle operation battery; (2) strict subset: verdict equals the frozen evaluator on the reference policy; (3) empty: deny-all by pre-construction convention (see empty-set cases), never the caller policy; (4) superset, partial overlap and disjoint (any element outside the caller set): the adapter refuses the input, builds no policy, and no operation is ever allowed that the caller policy denies.
failure_means: Any operation allowed under the adapter-built policy that the caller policy denies (widening), or a divergent verdict for the equal or subset row.
basis: safe_executor.py:374-387 and 413-414 at the pin; docs/p1-extraction-plan/04-component-ownership-and-adapter-matrix.md adapter matrix row F1a+F1b ('Runtime re-verifies each set is a subset of the caller's') and decision 4; 07 QG-01/QG-07 rows.
